mentions.name: Paste Redactor
mentions.description: A tool that redacts personally identifiable information (PII) from clipboard content when copying and pasting text, using a custom-trained local AI model so that PII never leaves the device. It is being extended into a privacy protection layer for AI agents: data passes through the local protection layer (with labels) before being sent to cloud models and is reconstructed locally when results return — described as like an adblocker, but for agents and private data.
mentions.problem: Powerful cloud AI models need access to local files to be useful, which risks exposing private data; this tool keeps PII on-device and protects data before it is sent to the cloud.
mentions.source_excerpt: Paste Redactor. It redacts Personable Identifiable Information (PII) from your clipboard when you copy and paste text. It uses a custom trained local AI model so that your PII never leaves your device.
